## Pull Request Template

### Summary
<!-- 2-3 sentence description of what this PR does and why -->

### Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Refactoring
- [ ] Security fix
- [ ] Infrastructure change
- [ ] Documentation update

### Linked Issue
<!-- Format: MID-### -->

### Testing Performed
- [ ] Unit tests pass (`pytest` / `npm test`)
- [ ] Integration tests pass
- [ ] Manual testing completed
- [ ] Tested on staging environment

### Checklist
- [ ] Code follows project style guidelines
- [ ] Self-reviewed for issues
- [ ] Changes are limited to the linked issue scope
- [ ] No secrets or credentials committed
- [ ] Dependent changes are staged appropriately
- [ ] Documentation updated (if applicable)

### Screenshots / Before & After
<!-- Required for UI changes; optional otherwise -->

### Additional Notes
<!-- Any deployment considerations, migration steps, or reviewer notes -->
